questions.title: Govt rolls out GOBARdhan rules with assured CBG offtake, 10-year price support
questions.subject: governance
questions.q: Which figure fills the blank correctly?
items: The government’s ______-crore GOBARdhan scheme aims to give India’s CBG industry a more predictable business model, with assured offtake, a government-backed price for at least 10 years and capital support.
questions.why: The report says: “The government’s Rs 23,731-crore GOBARdhan scheme aims to give India’s CBG industry a more predictable business model, with assured offtake, a government-backed price for at least 10 years and capital support.”
